scope: User-facing bibliography metadata checks plus supporting parser, citation-usage, retrieval, evidence, resume and review invariants. This is an explicit case catalog, not a statement of exhaustive code branch coverage.

coverage_layers.corpus_replay: Executable tests consume the supplied real-paper corpus, labelled variants or parser/AUX fixtures; real provider adapters and audit orchestration run with controlled HTTP.
coverage_layers.existing_regression: Existing regression exercises the invariant using its own inputs. A related real-paper context is listed for exploration, not claimed as a new end-to-end replay.
coverage_layers.corpus_consensus: Shared matching and consensus run against normalized source-linked real-paper facts. Controlled duplicated sources and failures are labelled; HTTP parsing is exercised separately by corpus_replay.

excluded: Scientific claim support, pages, volume and edition are outside automated metadata verdicts.
External benchmark acquisition/evaluator internals, packaging and every UI layout detail are outside this bibliography case catalog.
Live services can fail or change; live verdicts are observations and are not frozen gold labels.

rules.description: Pinned, complete preprint control.
Valid first-author prefix followed by the BibTeX others sentinel.
Swap the first two real authors.
Wrong first given name while preserving the real family name.
Compatible initials remain insufficient to confirm full given names.
Missing input authors with an exact pinned source identifier.
Truncation without an others marker is a mismatch.
An incorrect author prefix cannot be a partial match.
A bare others sentinel confirms no named author prefix.
Deliberately change 2024 to 2023.
A missing input year remains unverified.
A small title change still identifies the paper but is flagged.
An identifier alone cannot validate a citation with no title.
Correct DOI cannot validate a wholly unrelated title.
An unversioned input accepts the corresponding pinned source version.
A different real arXiv ID must be rejected before title fallback rediscovers CodeNav.
Normalize an HTTPS DOI wrapper and DOI letter case.
Another real ACL DOI is an explicit mismatch, not proof of identity.
Extract DOI from its URL, then discover the publication through the venue catalog.
A venue abbreviation produces review rather than an invented venue correction.
An omitted venue is explicitly not checked.
Real accented names are preserved.
Equivalent LaTeX and Unicode accent spellings compare equal.
Complete direct JMLR control.
JMLR year/catalog discovery without a direct URL or volume.
Volume routing works without a year; the absent year remains unknown.
Retrieve by the explicit JMLR locator while refusing to confirm a missing title.
Pages, volume, edition and a test claim are outside the metadata decision scope.
Verify a public accepted OpenReview forum record using its note ID.
No title, locator or other metadata: all six sources are inapplicable.
Archive discovery without year, volume or direct locator must request context.
Retrieve an authoritative real-paper record through the arxiv adapter.
Retrieve an authoritative real-paper record through the pmlr adapter.
Retrieve an authoritative real-paper record through the jmlr adapter.
Retrieve an authoritative real-paper record through the acl_anthology adapter.
Retrieve an authoritative real-paper record through the neurips adapter.
Retrieve an authoritative real-paper record through the openreview adapter.
Reject malformed without producing a partial parsed bibliography.
Reject duplicate-keys without producing a partial parsed bibliography.
Reject duplicate-fields without producing a partial parsed bibliography.
Reject undefined-macro without producing a partial parsed bibliography.
Reject invalid-author without producing a partial parsed bibliography.
Explicit Latin-1 decoding succeeds; UTF-8 fails; original bytes survive.
Expand string macros and retain preambles, custom fields and crossref locators.
Accept an empty bibliography with no fabricated entries.
Scope verification to cited keys.
Follow nested AUX inputs once, including cycles.
Match keys case-insensitively and ignore commented citations.
Warn about unknown citation keys.
A wildcard selects every reference.
No citations leaves no eligible references.
Reject malformed AUX input before verification.
Reject biblatex AUX input before verification.
Reject missing-input AUX input before verification.
403 is an access failure, not an invalid citation.
A large Retry-After is bounded and recorded as rate limiting.
503 retries stop within the attempt budget.
Read timeouts remain source failures after bounded retries.
Malformed successful HTTP payloads remain source failures.
404 is a missing record, not proof of invalid metadata.
Transient 503 responses can recover to a verified match.
Agreement between indexes cannot establish correctness.
Conflicting authoritative years require review.
Multiple matching versions are ambiguous.
Index majority cannot override conflicting primary versions.
A preprint year does not disprove a later publication year.
Unavailable and inapplicable lookups do not inflate records found.

Anonymous and unpublished notes retain uncertain authors/year/status.
